announcement.goals.gexpress.bomb_special: Plant explosives on your targets and eliminate everyone aboard.
announcement.goals.gexpress.medic: Give a passenger a protective shield and keep the train alive.
announcement.goals.gexpress.snitch: Complete tasks to uncover the killers hiding aboard.
announcement.goals.gexpress.cataloger: Compare the five listed passengers and work out which facts belong to whom.
announcement.goals.gexpress.seer: Feel every death on the train and warn the passengers before it is too late.
announcement.goals.gexpress.twins: Use your spare body to be in two places at once and keep the passengers alive.
announcement.goals.gexpress.cupid: Make enough of the train fall in love and keep the lovers breathing.
announcement.goals.gexpress.sniffer: Inspect food and drink for poison, and sniff passengers for concealed contraband.
announcement.goals.gexpress.time_master: Turn back the last few seconds when the train falls apart.
announcement.goals.gexpress.the_silent: Phase through the train in Shadow March, emerge safely, then strike once you are solid again.
announcement.goals.gexpress.warlock: Mark a player and use their position to kill someone standing too close to them.
announcement.goals.gexpress.juggernaut: You are alone. Outlast every passenger and every killer.
announcement.goals.gexpress.trickster: Scramble identities, silence the train, dance the middle carts around, and kill while everyone doubts what they saw.
announcement.goals.gexpress.puppetmaster: Take control of living players and turn the train against itself.
announcement.goals.gexpress.bounty_hunte: Hunt your current bounty before time runs out, or pay for the miss with locked weapons.
announcement.goals.gexpress.pelican: Swallow living players, keep them hidden, and eat enough of the lobby to win alone.
announcement.goals.gexpress.doomsayer: Read the fates hiding behind familiar faces and complete the prophecy before a false omen consumes you.
announcement.goals.gexpress.skincrawler: Steal fresh faces from the dead and survive long enough for the train to doubt itself.
announcement.goals.gexpress.tracker: Mark suspects and keep eyes on the people who matter.
announcement.goals.gexpress.veteran: Stand alert and let old instincts turn a killing blow aside before it finds its mark.
announcement.goals.gexpress.spy: Bug suspects, read their movements, and turn quiet details into evidence.
announcement.goals.gexpress.bodyguard: Stay close to your assigned person and keep them alive.
announcement.goals.gexpress.altruist: Revive up to two passengers and keep control over their borrowed lives.
announcement.goals.gexpress.vengeful_spi: Return after death and punish the player who killed you.
announcement.goals.gexpress.godfather: Build your family, keep your crew alive, and take the train from the shadows.
announcement.goals.gexpress.mafioso: Serve the Godfather and remove anyone standing in the family's way.
announcement.goals.gexpress.janitor: Serve the Godfather and make the evidence disappear.
announcement.goals.gexpress.pickpocket: Serve the Godfather and steal enough coins to keep the family armed.
announcement.goals.gexpress.burglar: Serve the Godfather and break through whatever keeps the family out.
announcement.goals.gexpress.copycat: Copy one ability at a time, use it quickly, and survive on borrowed tricks.
announcement.goals.gexpress.dracula: Feed before your blood runs dry, turn passengers into Vampires, and let the Covenant take the train.
announcement.goals.gexpress.vampire: Feed before your blood runs dry and help Dracula take the train.
announcement.goals.gexpress.rat: Stay small, infect every surviving passenger, then survive the 30-second hunt while everyone can see you.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
Once trusted to keep the railway clear, the Bomb Specialist now sees every crowded carriage as a carefully measured blast radius.

C4 can be planted on passengers or thrown into the environment before being armed. The warning beeps arrive late; by then, panic usually does the rest.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lInstinct§r
See living players and §4Killer Cohorts§r through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lAthletic§r
Sprint without exhausting stamina.

{icon:knife} §lDemolitions§r
Purchase C4 from the shop. Attach it directly to a passenger or throw it onto a surface, then use a Detonator to arm your deployed charges.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Medic boarded expecting motion sickness and minor accidents, not a train full of murderers.

They can entrust one passenger with a protective shield and follow that patient through walls. Choosing the right person can prevent a killing; trusting the wrong one can protect the killer instead.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:sense} §lProtective Shield§r
Use Primary Ability while looking at a nearby passenger. Their next lethal knife or gun hit destroys the shield instead, and the impact alerts you.

{icon:instinct} §lPatient Sense§r
Your protected passenger glows through walls until the shield breaks or is replaced.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Snitch knows that accusations mean nothing without proof. Every completed task brings them closer to the identities everyone else is desperate to hide.

Finish enough work and the surviving killers are exposed only to you. Stay alive long enough to make that information useful.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lGather Evidence§r
Complete tasks to fill your evidence requirement. Once complete, every living killer is revealed through walls.

{icon:sense} §lIdentify§r
After Evidence is complete, look directly at a revealed killer to read their exact role.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Cataloger keeps careful passenger manifests, recording the details everyone else overlooks. At the beginning of the journey, one page is marked with five faces and a handful of useful facts.

The facts describe the group as a whole, never tying a role or alignment to a particular passenger. The rest is left to the Cataloger's judgment.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:sense} §lCatalog§r
At the beginning of the round, receive five random living passengers. The note tells you whether none, one, or multiple listed players are evil and does the same for civilians. Neutral roles count as evil. It also reveals one role held by a random player on the list without identifying which player has it.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
Death leaves an impression that the Seer cannot ignore. Every murder flashes across their vision, no matter where it happened.

The living are harder to read. By comparing two souls, the Seer can learn whether they stand together without learning exactly what either of them is.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:sense} §lDeath Sense§r
Your vision flashes red whenever another passenger dies.

{icon:instinct} §lSoul Read§r
Use Primary Ability on one nearby living passenger, then on a second. You learn whether the pair share the same allegiance.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
Two bodies, one passenger. The Twins begin apart, yet each body remains an anchor for the same mind.

A live feed shows what the unattended twin can see, while nearby voices are carried between them. Swapping at the right moment can create an alibi or escape an ambush.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:swap} §lTwin Swap§r
Use Primary Ability to exchange places with your other body. Your skin, held equipment, and camera feed follow the active connection. Cooldown: 30 seconds by default.

{icon:sense} §lRemote Voice§r
Use Secondary Ability to toggle voices around your unattended body on or off. The relay starts disabled each round.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Sniffer does not need laboratory equipment to recognize poison or concealed weaponry. One careful breath is enough.

Besides spotting poisoned servings, they can inspect a nearby passenger for weapons and criminal tools from Wathe and its installed role add-ons.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:sense} §lPoison Sense§r
Poisoned food platters and drink trays are visibly marked for you before anyone takes from them.

{icon:spy} §lContraband Sniff§r
Look at a nearby player and use Primary Ability. You are privately told whether they carry killer weapons, revolvers, poison, explosives, criminal tools, or supported neutral-role weapons.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Time Master carries an emergency no clock was designed to survive. With one activation, the recent past can be made current again.

Lives, positions, inventories, purchases, coins, effects, cooldowns, and ability states return to their recorded snapshot. Only the Time Master remembers that the discarded future happened.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:sense} §lRewind§r
Use Primary Ability to restore the round to a recent snapshot. Rewind has limited uses and a separate cooldown.

{icon:undercover} §lFreeze§r
Use Secondary Ability on a nearby passenger to suspend them in place for a short time. Freeze has its own cooldown.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
Nobody hears The Silent approach, and the walls are not as solid to them as they are to everyone else.

Shadow March turns the train itself into a hidden route. It grants terrifying mobility, but weapons remain unusable until The Silent returns to a safe position.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lInstinct§r
See living players and §4Killer Cohorts§r through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lAthletic§r
Sprint without exhausting stamina.

{icon:instinct} §lShadow March§r
Enter a faster, silent shadow form that can move horizontally through solid blocks. Knives and guns are sealed until the march ends, when you return to the nearest safe full-height space.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Warlock rarely needs to stand beside the person they intend to kill. A marked passenger can carry the curse into a crowd for them.

Once the mark is in position, the Warlock attacks through it and leaves distance, confusion, and the wrong witness behind.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lInstinct§r
See living players and §4Killer Cohorts§r through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lAthletic§r
Sprint without exhausting stamina.

{icon:instinct} §lMark§r
Use Primary Ability on a nearby passenger to bind your curse to them. Only one mark may exist; changing targets triggers the mark cooldown.

{icon:knife} §lHex Kill§r
The knife omen above your hotbar turns red when somebody is close enough to your mark. Use Secondary Ability to kill one random passenger within the mark's reach.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Juggernaut belongs to no team and accepts no partner. Every locked door is merely a promise the train has not yet learned to keep.

They board fully armed, gathering momentum with every life taken. When a carriage tries to contain them, one brutal charge leaves the doorway broken at their feet for the rest of the journey.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:athletic} §lEndurance§r
Carry twice the stamina of a Civilian.

{icon:knife} §lArmed Alone§r
Start with a Knife and Revolver. Each weapon begins with a separate 120-second cooldown.

{icon:icon_weapon_cooldown_refresh} §lMomentum§r
A kill reduces only that weapon's future cooldown by 20 seconds. Knife cooldowns can fall to 20 seconds; Revolver cooldowns can fall to 40 seconds.

{icon:athletic} §lDoor Break§r
Use Primary Ability while aiming at either broad face of a nearby Wathe small wooden door. The door falls away in the direction you are looking and remains down. Cooldown: 45 seconds.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
Cupid boarded alone and intends to make sure nobody else leaves that way.

They bind pairs of passengers into Lovers whose lives rise and fall together. Create enough couples and Cupid wins by turning the train into one dangerously connected affair.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:athletic} §lEndurance§r
Carry twice the stamina of a Civilian.

{icon:swap} §lMatchmake§r
Use Primary Ability on one nearby living passenger, then on another, to bind them as Lovers. When one Lover dies, their partner follows.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Harlequin considers identity, location, and even the order of the train to be suggestions rather than facts.

Their performances replace reliable testimony with chaos: familiar faces become strangers, voices fall silent, passengers vanish, and entire carriages change places.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lInstinct§r
See living players and §4Killer Cohorts§r through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lAthletic§r
Sprint without exhausting stamina.

{icon:swap} §lMasquerade§r
Use Primary Ability to shuffle every living passenger's appearance, mute their voice, and scatter them among distinct safe positions.

{icon:swap} §lDancing Carts§r
Use Secondary Ability to rearrange the middle train cars. The engine and final car remain fixed, while entities inside each moved carriage travel with it.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Puppetmaster kills with borrowed hands. From another passenger's eyes, they can walk, look, carry a weapon, and turn an unwilling body into the perfect suspect.

The victim knows they are being controlled. Everyone else only sees what the Puppetmaster wants them to see.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lInstinct§r
See living players and §4Killer Cohorts§r through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lAthletic§r
Sprint without exhausting stamina.

{icon:undercover} §lPuppet Strings§r
Use Primary Ability to choose a living passenger. You see through their eyes and directly control their movement, view, hotbar, and temporary weapon until the possession ends.

{icon:instinct} §lUnwilling Vessel§r
The controlled passenger receives a red warning overlay but cannot take back control.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
Some killers enjoy the work. The Bounty Hunter prefers a contract, a deadline, and payment on delivery.

A designated passenger becomes the active bounty. Collecting on time pays well; allowing the contract to expire leaves both weapons locked down when they may be needed most.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lInstinct§r
See living players and §4Killer Cohorts§r through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lAthletic§r
Sprint without exhausting stamina.

{icon:knife} §lActive Contract§r
Receive a timed target and eliminate them before the contract expires to earn coins. Failure applies a long cooldown to both your Knife and Revolver.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Pelican's appetite is large enough to make passengers disappear without leaving a body behind.

Swallowed victims remain alive inside the belly, where their messages become intrusive popups shared only with the others trapped there. If the Pelican dies, every survivor inside is released.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:athletic} §lEndurance§r
Carry twice the stamina of a Civilian.

{icon:instinct} §lSwallow§r
Use Primary Ability on a nearby living passenger to imprison them inside your belly. Swallowed players remain vulnerable to delayed lethal effects.

{icon:knife} §lDigest§r
Open your inventory to see every swallowed passenger. Their digestion reaches 100% after two minutes; click a ready slot to digest them. Digestion has a 30-second cooldown.

{icon:swap} §lSpit Out§r
Use Secondary Ability to release one swallowed passenger at your position.

{icon:sense} §lBelly Popups§r
Use Tertiary Ability to free your cursor, close belly-chat popups, and return to the game. Swallow or digest enough of the lobby to win alone.
hud.gexpress.pelican.popup_cursor_hint: Press [%s] to free the cursor for belly popups
screen.gexpress.pelican.popup_cursor_hin: Press [%s] again or Esc to return
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Doomsayer does not investigate the train; they listen for the ending it is already trying to tell. Every passenger carries a fate, and every true name spoken brings the final vision into sharper focus.

Prophecy is unforgiving. A fulfilled fate falls silent forever, while a false omen may cloud an earlier revelation—or claim the prophet who dared to speak it.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:athletic} §lEndurance§r
Carry twice the stamina of a Civilian.

{icon:sense} §lForetell§r
Open your inventory, choose an unguessed living passenger, then type and select their role. Correct prophecies raise your counter; reach the configured goal to win alone.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Skincrawler understands that a familiar face is often a stronger disguise than invisibility.

A fresh corpse provides a new identity, while the Skincrawler's discarded appearance remains on the body. Investigators may find the evidence they expect and still reach the wrong conclusion.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lInstinct§r
See living players and §4Killer Cohorts§r through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lAthletic§r
Sprint without exhausting stamina.

{icon:undercover} §lBorrowed Skin§r
Use Primary Ability on a fresh body to adopt that passenger's appearance. Your previous skin is left on the corpse.

{icon:sense} §lStagger§r
The first gunshot staggers instead of killing you. A second shot while staggered is fatal.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Painter does not remove evidence; they improve it until it tells the wrong story.

Bodies can be given false roles and causes of death, while living suspects can be painted to mislead investigators.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lInstinct§r
See living players and §4Killer Cohorts§r through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lAthletic§r
Sprint without exhausting stamina.

{icon:undercover} §lPaint Evidence§r
Use Primary Ability on a body to forge its reported role and death message, or on a living passenger to forge the role seen by investigations. Killer cohorts see a fading tint on painted targets.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Tracker turns suspicion into a trail they can follow. Marked passengers remain visible through walls, no matter how crowded the carriage becomes.

A short list of carefully chosen suspects is useful. A long list of everyone is only glowing noise.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lTrack§r
Use Primary Ability on a nearby living passenger to add or remove them from your tracked list. Every tracked target glows only for you.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Veteran has survived enough ambushes to hear danger in a footstep and hesitation in a trigger pull. When they go on Alert, old instincts move before thought: knives glance away, bullets lose their mark, and a grenade's promise goes unanswered.

The attacker lives to regret the attempt. A Psycho swinging their Bat, however, is too wild for training to predict. Each Alert lasts fifteen seconds and is spent whether danger arrives or the carriage stays quiet.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:sense} §lAlert§r
Use Primary Ability to stand Alert for 15 seconds. The first knife, gunshot, grenade, targeted role ability, or guess against you is cancelled and consumes the Alert without harming its author. A Bat swung during Psycho mode still kills you. By default, you have 5 Alerts per round.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Spy buys information instead of waiting for witnesses to volunteer it.

A planted bug quietly reports a passenger's tasks and interactions, and can relay nearby voices directly to the Spy.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:sense} §lPlant Bug§r
Use Primary Ability on a nearby living passenger to spend coins and monitor them temporarily. Your private feed records completed tasks and player interactions.

{icon:spy} §lListen In§r
While a bug is active, hold Secondary Ability to privately hear the bugged passenger and living players speaking near them. The listening meter lasts 10 seconds and takes 20 seconds to recharge fully while released.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Bodyguard receives one assignment at the beginning of the round and is expected to remain close, alert, and alive.

Proximity grants a temporary Revolver. Wander too far and the weapon is removed, leaving the protected passenger without their escort.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:knife} §lClose Protection§r
Remain within 5 blocks of your assigned passenger to carry a temporary Revolver. Leaving the protection radius removes it without erasing its existing cooldown.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Altruist can lend life to two fallen passengers without surrendering their own.

Those lives remain tied to the Altruist, who receives reports about their actions and can withdraw either life at will.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:sense} §lRevive§r
Use Primary Ability while looking at a nearby body to revive its owner. You can revive up to two players, and bodies older than 60 seconds cannot be revived.

{icon:knife} §lWithdraw Life§r
Look at one of your revived players and use Secondary Ability to end their borrowed life. If only one remains, Secondary Ability works without aiming at them. Their interactions and completed tasks are reported to you.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
Most victims leave behind a body. The Vengeful Spirit leaves behind unfinished business.

After being murdered, they return briefly at the scene with one purpose and one weapon. Revenge must be exact; there is no second haunting.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:knife} §lRevenge§r
Shortly after another player kills you, return at your death position with a temporary Knife. Kill your murderer before the revenge window expires or return to spectator form.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Godfather begins with ambition, ammunition, and an empty family.

Recruit passengers into specialized Mafia roles, replace fallen members when a slot reopens, and control the train through loyalty rather than public trust. The family wins together when no opposition remains.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lFamily Instinct§r
See only living members of your Mafia through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lEndurance§r
Carry twice the stamina of a Civilian.

{icon:undercover} §lRecruit§r
Use Primary Ability on a nearby passenger, then recruit them as a Mafioso, Janitor, Pickpocket, or Burglar if that role is enabled and its family slot is available.

{icon:bullet} §lLoaded Favor§r
Start with a Revolver and limited loaded ammunition. Loaded shots ignore ordinary weapon cooldown; shop-bought Bullets can be loaded up to the weapon's capacity.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Mafioso is the family's direct answer to resistance. Subtlety is optional; loyalty is not.

Their shop is limited to practical killing tools, and every action should leave the Godfather closer to controlling the train.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lFamily Instinct§r
See only living members of your Mafia through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lEndurance§r
Carry twice the stamina of a Civilian.

{icon:knife} §lEnforcer§r
Your restricted shop offers a Knife, Revolver, and Grenade. Revolver kills apply the Mafia's extended gun cooldown.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Janitor understands that a murder scene is only dangerous while something remains to investigate.

Bodies can be removed before anyone reads them, while poisoned refreshments provide a quieter way to create the next cleanup.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lFamily Instinct§r
See only living members of your Mafia through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lEndurance§r
Carry twice the stamina of a Civilian.

{icon:sense} §lClean Up§r
Look at a nearby body until it highlights, then use Primary Ability to erase it from the scene.

{icon:poison_vial} §lPoisoner§r
Purchase Poison Vials and contaminate food platters or drink trays.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Pickpocket funds the family one distracted passenger at a time.

A brief touch may go unnoticed, while lingering too long alerts the victim. Every successful theft is divided among the surviving Mafia.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lFamily Instinct§r
See only living members of your Mafia through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lEndurance§r
Carry twice the stamina of a Civilian.

{icon:undercover} §lPickpocket§r
Hold Primary Ability while aiming at a nearby passenger to steal coins. Longer attempts take more but warn the victim sooner; the proceeds are shared with living family members.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
Locked doors are meant to keep threats outside. The Burglar makes that assumption dangerous.

They supply the Mafia with access to restricted rooms, turning keys, locks, and private hiding places into temporary inconveniences.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lFamily Instinct§r
See only living members of your Mafia through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lEndurance§r
Carry twice the stamina of a Civilian.

{icon:crowbar} §lBreak In§r
Purchase Crowbars and Lockpicks from your specialized shop to force access through secured doors.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
The Copycat has no signature talent of their own and considers that an advantage.

Observe the right passenger, borrow the right role, and spend the stolen ability before it expires. A role already copied once cannot be harvested again that round.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:athletic} §lEndurance§r
Carry twice the stamina of a Civilian.

{icon:swap} §lCopy Ability§r
Use Primary Ability on a nearby passenger to copy their current role kit temporarily. Copied roles expire, trigger Copycat's cooldown, and cannot be copied twice in the same round.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
Dracula is the first name in the Covenant and the source of every Vampire that follows.

Blood is both survival and currency. Feed only when starving, spend a nearly full reserve to create allies, and remember that every living Vampire makes Dracula's own hunger grow faster.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:athletic} §lEndurance§r
Carry twice the stamina of a Civilian.

{icon:knife} §lFang Bite§r
Use Primary Ability on a nearby non-Covenant passenger to kill and feed, restoring half of the Blood bar. Bite has a 45-second cooldown.

{icon:swap} §lBat Form§r
Use Secondary Ability to become a flying bat for up to 10 seconds. Horizontal flight is faster than ordinary creative flight; use Jump and Sneak to rise and descend, or cancel early to preserve charge. A fully drained meter takes time to regenerate.

{icon:sense} §lCreate Vampire§r
At 75% Blood or higher, use Tertiary Ability on a non-Covenant passenger. They join the Covenant as a Vampire and your Blood falls to 20%.

{icon:sense} §lBlood Hunger§r
Reaching empty Blood kills you. Each living Vampire multiplies Dracula's drain rate by 1.05.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
A Vampire is a passenger remade by Dracula and bound to the Covenant's survival.

They cannot create more Vampires, but they share the same hunger and may inherit leadership. When Dracula dies, the Covenant begins consuming its own members twice as quickly.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:athletic} §lEndurance§r
Carry twice the stamina of a Civilian.

{icon:knife} §lFang Bite§r
Use Primary Ability on a nearby non-Covenant passenger to kill and feed, restoring half of the Blood bar. Bite has a 45-second cooldown.

{icon:sense} §lOrphaned Covenant§r
Your Blood drains faster than Dracula's and twice as fast while no living Dracula remains. The first surviving Vampire to feed on 3 non-Covenant passengers becomes the next Dracula.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge:
Something small has slipped aboard, and it intends to leave every surviving passenger carrying the same infection.

Once everyone is infected, hiding is over: the Rat glows to the entire train for 30 seconds. If Pest Control cannot kill it before the countdown ends, the Rat wins alone.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lInfect§r
Use Primary Ability on a nearby living passenger to infect them. Cooldown: 25 seconds. Infected passengers glow only for you.

{icon:swap} §lDisappear§r
Use Secondary Ability to become completely invisible for up to 10 seconds. A fully depleted charge requires 60 seconds to recover.

{icon:undercover} §lPlay Dead§r
Use Tertiary Ability to leave a convincing, correctly scaled body and hide motionless. Use it again to stand up.

{icon:athletic} §lVermin Endurance§r
Carry twice a Civilian's stamina and regenerate it twice as quickly.

{icon:undercover} §lSmall Target§r
Your living and dead scales are 0.33. You retain a normal Minecraft jump and remain invisible during safe preparation.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.modifier.des:
You boarded with the training and tools to make explosives somebody else's problem.

Start with single-use Pliers capable of defusing C4 attached to a passenger or placed in the world. A failed wire cut detonates the charge immediately.

The far end of a carriage has become little more than a rumor.

Players, bodies, and dropped items disappear beyond your limited viewing distance, forcing you to investigate from dangerously close range.

Dark carriages no longer conceal their contents from you.

Your vision remains clear in low light while this modifier is active.

One serving is never enough.

You may take and carry additional food from platters.

The journey has left you unusually thirsty.

You may take and carry additional drinks from trays.

You can hear every nearby voice, but nobody can hear yours.

gui.gexpress.config.group.map.randomSpaw: Player-spawn slots used for random teleports. Each entry is 'x y z yaw pitch'. Use the entry delete controls to remove individual spots.
gui.gexpress.config.maps.snapshotWathe.t: On save, snapshots the current Wathe play/ready/lobby areas, spawns, and RTP slots into this map preset.
gui.gexpress.config.maps.randomSpawns.im: On save, copies the world's current /g setup rtp slots into this map preset.
gui.gexpress.config.maps.randomSpawns.cl: On save, removes every random spawn position from this map preset.
gui.gexpress.config.option.map.box.toolt: Enter as 'minX minY minZ maxX maxY maxZ' (six numbers separated by spaces).
gui.gexpress.config.option.map.pos.toolt: Enter as 'x y z yaw pitch' (five numbers separated by spaces).
gui.gexpress.config.option.map.offset.to: Enter as 'x y z' (three integers separated by spaces).
gui.gexpress.config.option.map.weather.t: Weather to apply while this preset is active.
gui.gexpress.config.option.map.defaultTr: Name of the train preset that loads with this map. Empty = none.
gui.gexpress.config.option.map.roomCount: Highest Wathe room key number this map can assign. A value of 15 gives Room 1 through Room 15 keys.
gui.gexpress.config.option.map.couchSlee: Allows non-creative players to sneak-right-click connected Wathe couch blocks to sleep while this map is active. Creative players can always use couch sleeping for setup and testing.

announcement.goals.gexpress.counterfeite: Forge deceptive civilian equipment and eliminate the passengers.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge: A killer who hides behind borrowed tools. The Counterfeiter’s work looks convincing, but appearances can be deceiving.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:sense} §lForge§r
Forge one piece of civilian equipment per match. Choose a Master Key, Trapper Trap, Medical Kit, Pill or Pan from your inventory.

{icon:knife} §lFragile Master Key§r
Opens doors like a real Master Key, but breaks after 3 uses.

{icon:instinct} §lFalse Report§r
The forged trap records nearby passengers. Its report contains one real role from someone other than its owner. Every other entry is false.

{icon:undercover} §lConvincing Props§r
The Medical Kit and Pill have no effect. The Pan can be raised, but cannot stun anyone.

A full hotbar leaves your forge available.
gexpress.counterfeiter.prop: Visual prop: cannot perform the real item’s actions.
gexpress.counterfeiter.forged: Forged %s. Your forge is used for this match.
gexpress.counterfeiter.full: Free a hotbar slot before forging.
announcement.goals.gexpress.loki: Deceive the passengers and eliminate them.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.desc.ge: A killer with a taste for mischief. Loki twists the senses, trades voices and leaves others holding the fuse.
gui.watheextended.guidebook.role.abiliti:
{icon:instinct} §lInstinct§r
See living players and §4Killer Cohorts§r through walls.

{icon:athletic} §lAthletic§r
Sprint without exhausting stamina.

{icon:swap} §lVoice Swap§r
Swap the voices of two nearby passengers. For 2 minutes, each voice comes from the other’s body.
Cooldown: 45 seconds.

{icon:sense} §lWarp§r
Curse a nearby passenger. After 15 seconds, their world turns upside down: gravity flips and movement controls reverse for 30 seconds.
Cooldown: 30 seconds.

{icon:knife} §lTrickster’s Fuse§r
Plant a curse that arms after 15 seconds. Its victim has 30 seconds to pass it to another passenger with a right-click. No passing straight back, and Loki cannot take it. The timer never resets. Whoever holds it at the end explodes, taking nearby passengers with them.
Cooldown: 1 minute.

{icon:undercover} §lClone§r
Leave your body behind and take control of a double for up to 3 minutes. The double can open doors, but cannot carry, buy or use items. Its death leaves a corpse and sends you back. Your unattended body remains vulnerable. Reactivate to return early.
Cooldown: 90 seconds.
gexpress.counterfeiter.key: Functional Master Key: breaks after 3 successful door uses.
gexpress.counterfeiter.trap: Trapper trap: reports one real non-owner role; all other entries are false.
gexpress.counterfeiter.pan: Can be raised like a Pan, but cannot stun players.
